question: In which of the following states of India is the Nokrek Biosphere Reserve located?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• The Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is situated in the West Garo Hills district of Meghalaya.
 
• It was established in 1988.
 
• It was designated a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in 2009.
 
• The core area of the reserve is the Nokrek National Park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Biodiversity:**

 
 
• The reserve is renowned for its rich biodiversity and unique ecosystem.
 
• It is a biodiversity hotspot, harboring a wide variety of flora and fauna.
 
• The reserve is known for its pristine forests, which include tropical deciduous, evergreen, and semi-evergreen forests.
 
• It is home to numerous endemic and endangered species.
 
• It is a habitat for the rare and endangered Red Panda.
 
• It is also a habitat for Asian elephants, tigers, leopards, and various species of deer.
 
• Many species of birds are found within the reserve.
 
• The reserve is known for its citrus gene sanctuary, which is home to wild relatives of citrus fruits.
